new_findings.title: bunit dependency is referenced but never used for Blazor component tests
new_findings.evidence_snippet:
<PackageReference Include="bunit"/>
// But only plain model validation tests exist — no component rendering.
// Core page logic remains untested: FindSuggestedPair, HandleKeyDown,
// CalculateResults, GetFilteredEntries, GeneratePartitions.
new_findings.rule_violated: Testing: bunit added to enable Blazor component testing but not utilized — creates false impression of component coverage
new_findings.remediation: Add bunit rendering tests for at least Setup, Judging, and Results pages, or remove bunit dependency if component testing will not be done.

new_findings.title: Export/Import delegation tests lack round-trip integration verification
new_findings.rule_violated: Testing: data integrity operations require round-trip verification (export, modify/wipe, import, verify)
new_findings.remediation: Add integration test using in-memory DbContext that: (1) seeds data, (2) exports via real DatabaseBackupService, (3) wipes context, (4) imports, (5) verifies all entities restored.

new_findings.title: BackupService.TryRestoreBackupAsync empty/null base64 branch untested
new_findings.remediation: Add test for TryRestoreBackupAsync where backup key exists but value is empty string or null localStorage return.

new_findings.title: ContestManager.CalculateGlobalScoresAsync null-category early-return untested
new_findings.rule_violated: Testing: error path for null/missing entity not covered
new_findings.remediation: Add test with mockCatRepo.Setup(r => r.GetByIdAsync("nonexistent")).ReturnsAsync((Category?)null) and assert Result.IsValid is false with expected error.

new_findings.title: DatabaseBackupService concrete implementation has zero direct tests
new_findings.rule_violated: Testing: concrete implementation of a critical backup interface has no coverage
new_findings.remediation: Add integration test for DatabaseBackupService using a temporary SQLite file: export data, verify file content, import into fresh context, verify data matches.

test_health_assessment.justification: Test count increased from 33 to 59 (+79%). New BackupServiceTests (5 tests, comprehensive coverage of backup/restore paths). New Web.Tests project (6 tests, model validation). 2 Theories converted in CoreTests. Critical TEST-004 fixed (no more null! abuse). TEST-008 fixed (central package management). But 7 of 13 original findings remain unresolved; TEST-002 and TEST-010 are only partially addressed. 5 new issues found including unused bunit dependency and branch coverage gaps.
strengths: BackupServiceTests are well-structured with mocked collaborators and cover save, restore-none, version-mismatch, valid-restore, corrupt-base64
ContestManager now depends on IDatabaseBackupService abstraction — no more null suppression
CoreTests properly uses [Theory] for parameterized boundary tests
ContestManagerTests Export/Import delegation tests verify correct dependency interaction
ValidationServiceTests have good Arrange/Act/Assert structure with explicit comments
weaknesses: 0 test traits/categories across all 59 tests — CI cannot filter integration vs unit
Web.Tests has bunit but zero component rendering tests — most complex page logic untested
No round-trip integration test for export/import data path
Repository edge cases (null IDs, duplicates, empty tables) still untested
E2E project uses NUnit while everything else is xUnit — framework inconsistency persists
ServiceCollectionExtensions (DI wiring) still has no test coverage
CoreTests class name still vague — contains Category + Entry tests in one file
TrimmingSafetyTests still suppresses the warning it should validate
No cancellation token support in any async test or underlying method
risk_areas: Web page logic (FindSuggestedPair, CalculateResults, keyboard handler) completely untested — highest risk for regression
DatabaseBackupService file-based operations untested — backup/restore is critical data path
No integration test category means CI runs everything or nothing — no middle ground
